contents: **Expansion cannot silently change an unqualified import root.** Final import validation rejects a relative import whose first segment has a macro-generated direct or named-import binding and a glob binding to a distinct definition in the same namespace. This applies to unused imports and to roots of longer import paths. Glob targets and intermediate path segments use the type namespace; conflicts confined to another namespace do not make those roots ambiguous. Repeated routes to one definition are not ambiguous. Source-written named bindings retain precedence; explicitly anchored paths bypass this unqualified-root check. Validation reports the conflict after expansion without replacing the combined named-and-glob lookup used during expansion.
